title: Multi-chunk private-key log redaction needs runtime confirmation
description: The engine log is read in fixed-size chunks and each chunk is sanitized separately. The sanitizer masks chunks containing an orphan BEGIN or END delimiter, but a private-key block spanning multiple chunks may have intermediate delimiter-free chunks. Whether such bytes reach a shared sink is not established.
claimed_root_cause: Per-chunk sanitization lacks state linking a private-key block across more than one chunk, so a delimiter-free middle chunk may not be recognized as key material.

trace.description: The engine log reader returns at most MAX_ENGINE_CHUNK bytes at a time.
Each returned text chunk is passed independently to sanitizeOrNull before append.

evidence.description: The sanitizer masks a chunk beginning at an orphan BEGIN through its end.
The sanitizer masks from the beginning of a chunk through an orphan END.

blockers: Whether a private-key block can span multiple read chunks with delimiter-free intermediate chunks in the actual logging path has not been observed.
Whether any such intermediate bytes reach a shared log copy under the deployed collector lifecycle is unverified.
The required OS-enforced sandbox is unavailable; no synthetic multi-chunk fixture was run.

validation_plan.local: In a compliant isolated fixture, feed a dummy PEM block split across three 256 KiB collector chunks, with the middle chunk containing only key-material markers and no delimiters. Inspect only the synthetic shared output to determine whether the middle marker is redacted.
validation_plan.deployment: Have the owner reproduce the same synthetic fixture against the shipped collector version and report whether the delimiter-free middle chunk is written to shared logs; do not use real key material.
